priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts:2 registers handler with socket.on("message", handler), while the changed cleanup at line 3 remains an empty function. The diff confirms this PR removed socket.off("message", handler), so disposal retains the listener and permits duplicate stale callbacks and unbounded listener retention across repeated attach/dispose cycles.
